name: UK energy price cap
summary: Cap £1,723; Cornwall Insight forecasts £1,999 in January, a 16% rise, below the 20% Alert line
state: The Ofgem cap for October–December is £1,723 a year. Cornwall Insight's latest January forecast, published on 30 Sep, is £1,999 for a typical dual-fuel household, up 16%; no later forecast had been found as of 6 Nov (Cornwall Insight; Uswitch). That is above the 5% Watch line but below the 20% Alert line and the £2,200 cap line, so the status moves to Watch. Ofgem announces the January cap by 25 Nov.
for_you: Households on standard variable tariffs would see bills rise from 1 Jan if the forecast holds. Ofgem and Citizens Advice publish guidance for anyone struggling to pay.
rubric_hit: Watch: forecast rise 16% (≥5%, <20%); cap £1,723 within £1,700–2,200 band

sources.title: Cornwall Insight — 16% price cap rise forecast in January
Uswitch — Comments on Cornwall Insight's January price cap prediction

why: The Ofgem cap sets bills for most UK households — a direct cost-of-living signal.
drivers: Wholesale gas and power prices, network costs, policy levies.

rubric.normal: Typical dual-fuel cap < £1,700/yr and next forecast change < +5%.
